section: Approaches and initiatives in AP industry - industrial policy, single desk, MSMEs, industrial nodes
subsections: Problems of AP MSMEs - arrears, credit, COVID
One District One Product items of AP

accepted.s: Which of the following is identified as a major credit-related problem faced by MSMEs in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Compulsory foreign ownership of all MSMEs
Credit and collateral gaps, particularly for women entrepreneurs
Abolition of institutional lending to MSMEs
accepted.x: Credit and collateral gaps, especially among women entrepreneurs, are identified as a major problem faced by MSMEs in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise problem rather than being distracted by unrelated policy measures.
accepted.sec: Problems of AP MSMEs - arrears, credit, COVID  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to delayed payments to MSMEs, consider the following statements:
1. MSME Samadhaan is associated with delayed-payment grievances.
2. The payment rule referred to for MSMEs prescribes a period of 45 days.
3. Delayed payment of incentives is unrelated to the MSME problem in Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: MSME Samadhaan and the 45-day payment rule are associated with delayed payments. Delayed incentive payments are also a recognised MSME grievance, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the statement that reverses the documented grievance and eliminate it.
accepted.sec: Problems of AP MSMEs - arrears, credit, COVID  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The escrow guarantee introduced under Industrial Development Policy 4.0 primarily seeks to address which issue concerning MSMEs?
accepted.x: The escrow guarantee mechanism under IDP 4.0 addresses the long-standing problem of arrears and delays in payment of industrial incentives to MSMEs.
accepted.tq: Match the institutional mechanism with the specific problem it is designed to solve.
accepted.sec: Problems of AP MSMEs - arrears, credit, COVID  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: ReSTART, launched by the Government of Andhra Pradesh in May 2020, was primarily intended as:
o: A COVID-19 relief package for MSMEs
A policy for foreign direct investment in defence
A programme for constructing industrial corridors
accepted.x: ReSTART was Andhra Pradesh’s COVID-19 relief package for MSMEs, launched in May 2020.
accepted.tq: Use the launch date and sector-purpose combination to distinguish the scheme from other industrial initiatives.

accepted.s: The approximate financial size of the ReSTART package for Andhra Pradesh MSMEs was:
accepted.x: The ReSTART package for MSMEs was valued at approximately ₹1,110 crore.
accepted.tq: Separate the scheme-specific amount from larger investment and project figures.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the principal use of the ReSTART package?
o: Clearing pending incentive arrears of MSMEs
Providing only export subsidies to large enterprises
Financing only new steel plants in Rayalaseema
accepted.x: The ReSTART package mainly cleared pending incentive arrears and provided COVID-19 relief to MSMEs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the principal objective of a scheme from unrelated sectoral initiatives.

accepted.s: Under the incentive provisions referred to for Andhra Pradesh, an additional capital subsidy of 5 per cent is available to entrepreneurs belonging to which groups?
o: Only large and mega industrial units
Only foreign investors and export houses
Women, SC, ST, BC and specially-abled entrepreneurs
accepted.x: A 5 per cent additional capital subsidy is available for women, SC, ST, BC and specially-abled entrepreneurs.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete beneficiary group instead of selecting a partial category.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding women, SC/ST, BC and specially-abled entrepreneurs in Andhra Pradesh:
1. They receive preferential access under the MSME policy.
2. They are eligible for an additional 5 per cent capital subsidy.
3. The additional capital subsidy is restricted exclusively to women entrepreneurs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The MSME policy provides preferential access to these groups, and the additional subsidy is 5 per cent. It is not restricted exclusively to women entrepreneurs.
accepted.tq: Reject the exclusive-word trap in a statement that narrows a wider beneficiary group.

accepted.s: According to the cited national figure, women own what percentage of MSMEs?
accepted.x: Women own 20.37 per cent of MSMEs according to the cited national figure.
accepted.tq: Treat a percentage as a distinct factual value and distinguish it from rounded alternatives.

accepted.s: Which of the following combination correctly identifies the schemes mentioned as supporting women entrepreneurs nationally?
o: VCIC loan and RAMP export meet
accepted.x: Stand Up India and MUDRA (Tarun) are the schemes mentioned as supporting women entrepreneurs.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure pair linking the beneficiary group to the relevant schemes.

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh has identified how many products under the One District One Product initiative?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has identified 99 products under the One District One Product initiative.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the ODOP count from other figures relating to CFCs, proposals and units.
accepted.sec: One District One Product items of AP  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The One District One Product initiative is implemented by:
o: DPIIT in association with the States
The Reserve Bank of India independently of the States
The ADB through the VCIC loan only
accepted.x: ODOP is run by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) with the States.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who runs the programme?’ test to distinguish the implementing body.
accepted.sec: One District One Product items of AP  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Product)
a. Udayagiri wooden cutlery
b. Paturu cotton silk sarees
c. Etikoppaka toys
d. Payakaraopeta silk sarees

List-II (District)
i. Anakapalli
ii. Nellore

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Udayagiri wooden cutlery and Paturu cotton silk sarees are associated with Nellore, while Etikoppaka toys and Payakaraopeta silk sarees are associated with Anakapalli.
accepted.tq: Start from the repeated district pair and verify the remaining product associations.
accepted.sec: One District One Product items of AP  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Chief Minister directed that all approved projects should:
o: Break ground by September 2026 and start operations by December 2028
Break ground by December 2028 and start operations by September 2026
Be completed by September 2025 and exported by December 2026
Receive approval by December 2026 and begin construction by 2030
accepted.x: The direction was that all approved projects should break ground by September 2026 and commence operations by December 2028.
accepted.tq: Keep the two deadlines in their correct sequence and do not reverse them.

accepted.s: During FY 2024-25, the SIPB approved projects in Andhra Pradesh involving investments of approximately:
accepted.x: SIPB approved projects involving approximately ₹2,45,275 crore in FY 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Separate the annual approved-investment figure from the cumulative investment figure for operational units.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the reported position of large and mega industrial units in Andhra Pradesh?
o: 1,119 units operational, involving ₹2,45,275 crore and 50-acre land allotments
87 units operational, involving ₹34,000 crore and 45,000 jobs
99 units operational, involving ₹1,110 crore and 20.37 lakh jobs
1,119 units operational, involving ₹3.15 lakh crore and 5.85 lakh jobs
accepted.x: The reported position was 1,119 operational large and mega units, involving ₹3.15 lakh crore and generating 5.85 lakh jobs.
accepted.tq: Keep related counts, investment and employment figures together instead of mixing figures from separate reports.

accepted.s: The FDI drive mentioned in relation to Andhra Pradesh was aimed at strategic sectors ahead of the:
accepted.x: The FDI drive was linked to strategic sectors ahead of the Visakhapatnam CII Partnership Summit.
accepted.tq: Link the investment initiative with its stated event rather than with another industrial programme.

accepted.s: Rayalaseema is being developed as a hub for which combination of sectors?
o: Maritime administration, education, health and mining
accepted.x: Rayalaseema is being developed into an automobile, steel, defence and space hub.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete sectoral combination and avoid replacing one sector with a neighbouring economic activity.

accepted.s: Which statement best reflects the criticism concerning Andhra Pradesh’s industrial performance?
o: Manufacturing growth remains subdued despite strong investment momentum
Investment momentum has completely stopped despite rapid manufacturing growth
Manufacturing has expanded only because all projects are in Rayalaseema
Industrial growth has been unaffected by delays in incentive payments
accepted.x: The criticism is that manufacturing growth remains subdued even though investment momentum is strong.
accepted.tq: Identify the carefully worded criticism rather than choosing an extreme reversal.

accepted.s: The Cabinet ratified 87 SIPB proposals worth approximately ₹34,000 crore primarily with the objective of promoting:
o: Environmental clearances for all central projects
accepted.x: The 87 proposals, valued at approximately ₹34,000 crore, were aimed at promoting development in backward regions.
accepted.tq: Match the proposal package with its stated regional-development objective.

accepted.s: Which feature is specifically associated with the revamped Andhra Pradesh MSME Policy 2026?
o: Replacement of MSMEs by industrial nodes
Restriction of benefits to mega industries
Withdrawal of support from women-led units
accepted.x: The revamped MSME Policy 2026 is described as favouring women-led units.
accepted.tq: Use the policy’s beneficiary focus to distinguish it from broad industrial policies.

accepted.s: The ‘Beyond Bengaluru’ strategy is associated with which State?
accepted.x: Karnataka’s ‘Beyond Bengaluru’ strategy seeks to build district-specific industrial nodes.
accepted.tq: Test the State-policy association directly, a common location trap.

accepted.s: District-specific industrial nodes are a feature of Karnataka’s:
accepted.x: The ‘Beyond Bengaluru’ strategy builds district-specific industrial nodes.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a comparative State strategy from Andhra Pradesh’s own MSME and approval initiatives.

accepted.s: Time-bound and faceless approvals are considered significant in a single-window system mainly because they:
o: Transfer all approvals to foreign agencies
Eliminate the need for all industrial investment
Restrict applications to large and mega units
accepted.x: Time-bound, faceless approvals reduce discretionary interaction and are therefore regarded as an anti-corruption measure in a single-window system.
accepted.tq: Infer the governance significance of a procedural reform from its operational features.

accepted.s: The ADB’s policy-based loan connected with Andhra Pradesh supports:
o: The ODOP product list without State participation
Ease of Doing Business reforms under VCIC
accepted.x: The ADB’s VCIC policy-based loan supports Ease of Doing Business reforms.
accepted.tq: Match the lending institution and corridor initiative with the reform objective.

accepted.s: The APIIC initiative mentioned in the current industrial context involves direct allotment of:
accepted.x: The APIIC initiative provides for 50-acre direct allotment.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the land-allotment figure from counts of proposals, products and CFCs.

accepted.s: What is the significance of the CGD deemed-approval Government Order mentioned in the industrial context?
o: It provides deemed approval in the city gas distribution context
It abolishes all approvals for mega projects
It introduces deemed approval for ODOP products only
It transfers environmental clearances to the ADB
accepted.x: The cited G.O. concerns deemed approval in the city gas distribution (CGD) context.
accepted.tq: Read the sector abbreviation and connect the approval reform to its relevant field.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: VCIC policy-based loan — Ease of Doing Business reforms
accepted.x: PARIVESH 3.0 is associated with environmental clearances, whereas E-Samudra is associated with maritime administration.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped function between two sector-specific single-window systems.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Comprehensive Development Plan mentioned in the current context includes how many Common Facility Centres (CFCs)?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Comprehensive Development Plan includes 45 Common Facility Centres.
accepted.tq: Separate the CFC count from the ODOP product count and SIPB proposal count.

accepted.s: The RAMP export meet mentioned in the industrial context is most directly associated with:
o: Construction of defence and space hubs only
accepted.x: The RAMP export meet is connected with MSME-related export support and activity.
accepted.tq: Use the programme’s export orientation to identify its likely sectoral purpose.

accepted.s: What is the flagship MSME goal of Andhra Pradesh described as ‘One Family, One Entrepreneur by 2030’?
o: To create one mega industry in every district by 2030
To provide one government job to every family by 2030
To encourage at least one entrepreneur in every family by 2030
To establish one export port in every district by 2030
accepted.x: ‘One Family, One Entrepreneur by 2030’ is Andhra Pradesh’s flagship MSME goal of promoting entrepreneurship at the family level.
accepted.tq: Translate the policy slogan into its precise programme objective without extending it to unrelated sectors.
